name: Nicolás Pascual de la Parte - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the EU should defend itself. It asks for much higher defence spending, more joint buying of weapons made in Europe, and continued military support for Ukraine. It wants faster EU decision-making on defence, better protection against cyber and hybrid attacks, and closer cooperation with NATO. The report is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for more spending, joint procurement and faster decisions.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, defence companies, soldiers and citizens funding defence.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Council decide whether to act on these requests.
